info.title: Update Inventory
info.description: Update the inventory quantity of SKUs belonging to a product. The SKU ID must belong to a product that is **not** in `FREEZE` or `DELETED` status.

post.description: Update the inventory quantity of SKUs belonging to a product. The SKU ID must belong to a product that is **not** in `FREEZE` or `DELETED` status.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

id.description:
The SKU ID generated by TikTok Shop. One product can contain multiple SKU IDs.

**Note**: 
- The SKU ID must belong to a product that is not in `FREEZE` or `DELETED` status.
- If you are updating multiple SKUs, all the SKU IDs must belong to the same product.

warehouse_id.description:
The ID of the warehouse where the SKU is stored. Retrieve this value from the [Get Product API](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6509d85b4a0bb702c057fdda).

**Note**: Optional if there is only 1 warehouse. Otherwise, please provide this ID.

quantity.description:
The total SKU quantity available in the warehouse.
Valid range: [1, 99,999]

Note: This quantity specifically refers to the in-stock inventory that can be shipped immediately.

backorder_quantity.description:
The `backorder_quantity` will automatically be converted to `quantity` once in-stock inventory is sold out. The fulfillment of this inventory follows the `handling_time` specified below.

Note: Any existing `backorder_quantity` will persist if no update is provided during API call.

handling_time.description: The estimated number of working days needed for a backorder to be shipped. Currently, different warehouses for the same SKU are not allowed to have different `handling_time`

inventory.description:
SKU inventory information.
**Note**: You must include all warehouse IDs assigned to this SKU, along with the respective quantity. Do not omit any or add unrelated warehouses.

skus.description: A list of Stock Keeping Units (SKUs) used to identify distinct variants of the product.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

sku_id.description: The ID of the SKU where the error occurred.

warehouse_id.description: The ID of the warehouse  where the error occurred.

extra_errors.description: A list of secondary errors or issues related to the main error.

detail.description: The details of the main error.

errors.description: The list of errors that occurred.
